title: The IMF package: a toolkit implementing mass functions and statistical tools to analyze them
description: Tools for sampling from and working with functional forms of the initial mass function (IMF), core mass function, and related mass distributions, including cluster sampling, multiplicity, and protostellar/pre-main-sequence utilities.
